title: Every recorded step has a thinking slot, the tools offered, and per-tool counts (D2, P2)
request: From Hermes Agent the owner wants three habits in DCLab's record: every model turn has a thinking slot (the real reasoning, or the agent's visible words before its tool call, or a marked none), the system prompt and tool list saved with every run, and per-tool counts with the same columns every time. The audit of 2026-10-23 had found the intern's visible reasoning unused ('no thought of its own') and no record of which tools a run could call.
spec: Plan D2 whole step record, package P2 (plans/yes-you-are-right-jaunty-parasol.md): Step.thought/thought_source, the intern's entries, the standard plan's sentences, thought_source on the agent.step event, tool counts and tool_names/tools_sha256 in the run record, a tools command, ReasoningSource 'visible' in dclab_core.
plan: read the loop, the tracer, the harness session, the intern's step records, the run hook and the contracts
thought_of(out): recorded reasoning, else visible words, else nothing; on every Step of the reply
the intern keeps the thought on its step entries; the standard plan's steps carry the plan's sentence
the trace passes thought_source to the agent.step event; the vocabulary gains the field (experience v13)
tool_counts with the same columns per policy, in the run record's params; tool_names and tools_sha256
dclab_core: ReasoningSource visible, Message.tool_call_id, the three example contracts to v2 with tools
tests on a scripted intern run; the adversarial review

decisions.decision: The thinking slot has three sources: recorded, visible, from_record; never an invented thought
decisions.why: Hermes keeps an empty <think> rather than changing the format; DCLab labels what filled the slot so a reasoning-only set can take recorded ones only

decisions.decision: The reply's visible words are labelled 'visible', a new ReasoningSource, not 'recorded'
decisions.why: they are the model's words at that moment but not its reasoning; mixing them into recorded reasoning would teach a model to think in replies

decisions.decision: The contract change moves ChatExample, PreferencePair and SolverTrajectory to v2 at once, with tools
decisions.why: the Literal is shared through Message and TrajectoryStep, so each frozen schema changed; v2 also carries the tools offered, which P4 fills, so the versions move once

decisions.decision: Per-tool counts live in the run record's params, not in outputs.numbers
decisions.why: event_payload keeps params whole and numbers only by count; the session's record is where the counts are read

decisions.decision: agent.step gains thought_source only; the thought text goes where the reply text already goes
decisions.why: the event vocabulary is a contract (experience v13); the text is in the session's steps and the exchange log, never cut

decisions.decision: A call to a tool not offered is counted under _not_offered and refused
decisions.why: the columns stay the same for every run of a policy, and a model that invents tools is measured

change: dclab_core/store.py (ReasoningSource visible, Message.tool_call_id, _reads(), chat_example v2, preference_pair v2, solver_trajectory v2 with tools), dclab_core/experience.py (agent.step thought_source, v13, v12 read as v13), dclab_core 0.101.0 + CHANGELOG + schemas and baselines; dclab_rnd/agents/runtime.py (Step.thought, RunResult.offered/tools_sha256, thought_of, tools_hash), agents/traces.py (thought_source to the hook), agents/harness.py (Session.moves), experience/hooks.py (tool_counts, params), experience/__main__.py (tools), intern/loop.py (STANDARD_THOUGHTS, entries), store/sets/llm.py (a step's own thought_source); tests/test_agent_thinking_slot.py (new); four tests moved to v13.

findings.defect: the intern's visible words before a tool call were never a step's thought
findings.scenario: store/sets/llm.py labelled every intern step 'the intern's step has no thought of its own' although the words were in the session's messages
findings.cause: step_record kept tool, arguments and result only
findings.fix: Step.thought from thought_of(out); the intern's entry keeps it with its source
alternatives: derive it later from the messages by reply index (fragile across versions of the loop)

findings.defect: the event vocabulary refused thought_source on agent.step ('fields not in the vocabulary'), so every step event of a run was dropped
findings.scenario: the first test run: test_agent_harness and test_experience_log lost their steps
findings.cause: the vocabulary is a closed contract; a field needs a version
findings.fix: experience v13 (v12 read as v13), baseline written, the tests naming v12 moved
findings.impact: a run without its steps in the record

findings.defect: the per-tool counts put in outputs.numbers never reached the run.recorded event (event_payload keeps only their count)
findings.scenario: the test read params/numbers and found none
findings.cause: numbers are the stage records' paths, flattened away for the event
findings.fix: the counts in params, which the event keeps whole
alternatives: a second event kind (a contract change for a table)

findings.defect: docs/DATA_CATALOG.md and data_catalog.json still named experience_event v12: rd-gates fails on a stale catalog
findings.cause: the generated catalog was not rebuilt after the event version moved
findings.fix: make catalog, the two files committed

findings.defect: tool_names, a joined string in the run's params, was silently cut to 300 characters by the event (the intern's 30 tools join to 377)
findings.scenario: the event kept '...approve_stage,g' and lost the rest; the test checked only the first name
findings.cause: event_payload's _short cuts every string in params
findings.fix: tool_names dropped: the calls:<tool> columns name every offered tool and tools_sha256 pins the set
findings.impact: a list that looked whole and was not
alternatives: one key per name (more columns for nothing)

findings.defect: a step's thought was not redacted in the store, while the same words under content or summary were
findings.scenario: _clean on a step whose thought held an e-mail address kept the address; intern_trajectories put it in trajectories/studio
findings.cause: shapers.TEXT_KEYS had no thought, reasoning or reasoning_content
findings.fix: the three keys added; shapers-7 so every kept session is shaped again
findings.impact: an unredacted copy of model text (the intern's purpose sees cells) in a training set
findings.open: the redactor's damage to code inside a thought: the known separate follow-up

findings.defect: the answer step (a reply without a tool call) had no thinking slot: said() took no thought_source
findings.scenario: a scripted reply with reasoning and no call: its agent.step event said nothing of the slot
findings.cause: thought_of was computed after the no-call path's trace call
findings.fix: said() takes thought_source; the loop passes it
findings.test: tests/test_agent_thinking_slot.py (the last event's thought_source is visible)

measurements.name: the new tests and the 20 files around the loop, the record, the intern and the contracts
measurements.result: all passed after F2 and F3 (292 then 147 tests)
measurements.next: the full gate and make core-wheel-check tonight; P4 fills tools on the examples
limits: no live model run: the recorded source is exercised with a scripted reply carrying reasoning

outcome: Every step of a model run and of the standard plan carries a thought with its source or says plainly it has none; the step event says what filled the slot; the run record names the tools offered, their hash, and counts calls, errors and refusals per tool with the same columns every run.
lessons: A field on an event is a contract change: move the version first, then write the field.
Read where a record's number ends up before putting a number there: the event flattens outputs.numbers to a count.
risks: a thought that is a reply's visible text can quote a tool result the model saw; the session file already holds those messages, so this is the same exposure, not a new one
runs recorded before v13 have no thought_source on their steps: the builders treat them as before
